notes: NWC construction (historical): NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents − Short-term investments) − (Total current liabilities − Short-term obligations and current maturities of long-term obligations). This excludes cash-like items and excludes the current portion of debt-like obligations to focus on operating working capital. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))
EBIT definition: GAAP operating income from the consolidated statements of income (used as EBIT). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

D&A definition: sum of (1) depreciation of property, plant and equipment and (2) amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets from the consolidated statements of cash flows. Alternative D&A definitions (e.g., including additional amortization lines) can change D&A%. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

Capex definition: purchases of property, plant and equipment from the consolidated statements of cash flows (capex is not net of asset sale proceeds). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

Tax rate anchor: base-case tax_rate is set to 0.08, consistent with company expectation that 2026 GAAP effective tax rate will be between 0.07 and 0.09. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

NOL balance: nol_balance is the sum of net operating loss carryforwards disclosed at Dec 31, 2025 across federal, state, and non-U.S. jurisdictions. Utilization percent is left null due to missing explicit forward utilization schedule at the company disclosure level. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))
current_price is taken from the latest available market feed immediately prior to the research date (latest trade shown as March 20, 2026 since March 21 is a weekend).
WACC, terminal growth, and terminal valuation method are modeler assumptions for the DCF pipeline (not explicitly provided as a single company-stated number in the filings).

catalysts: Sustained execution of the PPI Business System supporting ongoing productivity and operating-margin durability. ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Commercial momentum from product launches and increased adoption of integrated workflows (instruments + consumables + services). ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Measured value-creation from acquisitions and integration (impacting revenue growth, amortization profile, and cash conversion). ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
company_overview: Thermo Fisher operates across Life Sciences Solutions, Analytical Instruments, Specialty Diagnostics, and Laboratory Products & Biopharma Services. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

In FY2025, the company delivered $44.56B of revenue and $7.75B of GAAP operating income (17.4% operating margin). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

Capital deployment remains acquisition-led, with shareholder returns also significant; management reported ~$16.5B deployed in 2025. ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
current_context: FY2025 revenue grew 4% to $44.56B; organic revenue growth was 2%. ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

FY2025 GAAP operating income increased 6% to ~$7.75B and GAAP operating margin improved to 17.4% (from 17.1% in 2024). ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Management guided for a GAAP effective tax rate in 2026 of approximately 7% to 9% (used to anchor the base-case tax rate). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base case models a modest growth path (4.0% in 2026 tapering to 2.5% by 2030), consistent with the 2025 organic growth run-rate. ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

EBIT margin is held on a gentle upward trajectory to ~17.6% as operating leverage and productivity improvements normalize. ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Capital intensity is modeled in line with historical cash flow (capex ~3.4% of sales; depreciation/amortization normalizing to ~6.7%–7.0% of sales). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))

Working-capital intensity (NWC) is modeled in the low-to-mid teens as a percent of sales, reflecting the balance-sheet working capital profile. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Tax-rate volatility (global mix and discrete items) could affect realized cash taxes and effective tax rate assumptions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/97745/000009774526000018/tmo-20251231.htm))
Working-capital swings (receivables/contract balances/payables timing) may deviate from modeled NWC intensity and pressure free cash flow.

Integration/execution risk from ongoing M&A and strategic investments could pressure margins, increase amortization/charges, or delay synergies. ([ir.thermofisher.com](https://ir.thermofisher.com/investors/news-events/news/news-details/2026/Thermo-Fisher-Scientific-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
